audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Thessalonians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for day of Lord, sober watchfulness, armor as faith/love/hope, community practices, testing prophecy, whole sanctification, final grace.

verses.restored: Now concerning the times and the seasons, siblings, you have no need to be written to.

familiar.text: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

modern.text: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.

original.text: Περὶ δὲ τῶν χρόνων καὶ τῶν καιρῶν, ἀδελφοί, οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ὑμῖν γράφεσθαι,

verses.restored: For you yourselves know accurately that the day of the Lord comes unexpectedly, like a visitor in night.

familiar.text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

modern.text: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

original.text: αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκριβῶς οἴδατε ⸀ὅτι ἡμέρα κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης ἐν νυκτὶ οὕτως ἔρχεται.

verses.restored: When people say, Peace and security, then sudden reckoning comes upon them, like birth-pain, and it cannot simply be avoided.

familiar.text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

modern.text: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

original.text: ⸀ὅταν λέγωσιν· Εἰρήνη καὶ ἀσφάλεια, τότε αἰφνίδιος αὐτοῖς ἐφίσταται ὄλεθρος ὥσπερ ἡ ὠδὶν τῇ ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσῃ, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγωσιν.

verses.restored: But you, siblings, are not in darkness, so that the day should overtake you unexpectedly.

familiar.text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

modern.text: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.

original.text: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀδελφοί, οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σκότει, ἵνα ἡ ἡμέρα ὑμᾶς ὡς ⸀κλέπτης καταλάβῃ,

verses.restored: For you all are children of light and children of day; we are not of night nor of darkness.

familiar.text: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

modern.text: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

original.text: πάντες ⸀γὰρ ὑμεῖς υἱοὶ φωτός ἐστε καὶ υἱοὶ ἡμέρας. οὐκ ἐσμὲν νυκτὸς οὐδὲ σκότους·

verses.restored: So then let us not sleep as the rest do, but let us keep awake and be sober.

familiar.text: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

modern.text: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.

original.text: ἄρα οὖν μὴ καθεύδωμεν ⸀ὡς οἱ λοιποί, ἀλλὰ γρηγορῶμεν καὶ νήφωμεν.

verses.restored: For those sleeping sleep at night, and those becoming intoxicated are intoxicated at night.

familiar.text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

modern.text: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

original.text: οἱ γὰρ καθεύδοντες νυκτὸς καθεύδουσιν, καὶ οἱ μεθυσκόμενοι νυκτὸς μεθύουσιν·

verses.restored: But we, being of day, let us be sober, having put on breastplate of trust and love, and helmet of hope of salvation/healing.

familiar.text: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

modern.text: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.

original.text: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἡμέρας ὄντες νήφωμεν, ἐνδυσάμενοι θώρακα πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ περικεφαλαίαν ἐλπίδα σωτηρίας·

verses.restored: Because the Divine did not appoint us for condemnation, but for obtaining salvation/healing through our Lord Jesus Messiah,

familiar.text: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

modern.text: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: ὅτι οὐκ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς εἰς ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ εἰς περιποίησιν σωτηρίας διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

verses.restored: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.

familiar.text: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

modern.text: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.

original.text: τοῦ ἀποθανόντος ⸀περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα εἴτε γρηγορῶμεν εἴτε καθεύδωμεν ἅμα σὺν αὐτῷ ζήσωμεν.

verses.restored: Therefore comfort/encourage one another and build up one another, just as also you are doing.

familiar.text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

modern.text: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing. Christian Living

original.text: διὸ παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους καὶ οἰκοδομεῖτε εἷς τὸν ἕνα, καθὼς καὶ ποιεῖτε.

verses.restored: But we ask you, siblings, to know those laboring among you and standing before you in the Lord and admonishing you,

familiar.text: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

modern.text: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.

original.text: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, εἰδέναι τοὺς κοπιῶντας ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ προϊσταμένους ὑμῶν ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ νουθετοῦντας ὑμᾶς,

verses.restored: and to esteem them beyond measure in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.

familiar.text: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

modern.text: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.

original.text: καὶ ἡγεῖσθαι αὐτοὺς ⸀ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ διὰ τὸ ἔργον αὐτῶν. εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ⸀ἑαυτοῖς.

verses.restored: And we appeal to you, siblings: admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, hold close the weak, be patient toward all.

familiar.text: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

modern.text: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.

original.text: παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, νουθετεῖτε τοὺς ἀτάκτους, παραμυθεῖσθε τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους, ἀντέχεσθε τῶν ἀσθενῶν, μακροθυμεῖτε πρὸς πάντας.

verses.restored: See that no one repays harmfulness for harmfulness to anyone, but always pursue the good toward one another and toward all.

familiar.text: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

modern.text: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.

original.text: ὁρᾶτε μή τις κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ τινι ἀποδῷ, ἀλλὰ πάντοτε τὸ ἀγαθὸν ⸀διώκετε εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας.

verses.restored: Rejoice always.

familiar.text: Rejoice evermore.

modern.text: Rejoice at all times.

original.text: πάντοτε χαίρετε,

verses.restored: Pray without ceasing.

familiar.text: Pray without ceasing.

modern.text: Pray without ceasing.

original.text: ἀδιαλείπτως προσεύχεσθε,

verses.restored: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of the Divine in Messiah Jesus for you.

familiar.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

modern.text: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

original.text: ἐν παντὶ εὐχαριστεῖτε· τοῦτο γὰρ θέλημα θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς.

verses.restored: Do not quench the Spirit.

familiar.text: Quench not the Spirit.

modern.text: Do not extinguish the Spirit.

original.text: τὸ πνεῦμα μὴ σβέννυτε,

verses.restored: Do not despise prophecies,

familiar.text: Despise not prophesyings.

modern.text: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,

original.text: προφητείας μὴ ἐξουθενεῖτε·

verses.restored: but test all things; hold fast the beautiful/good.

familiar.text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

modern.text: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.

original.text: πάντα δὲ δοκιμάζετε, τὸ καλὸν κατέχετε,

verses.restored: Hold away from every form of harmfulness.

familiar.text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

modern.text: Abstain from every form of evil. Final Blessings and Instructions

original.text: ἀπὸ παντὸς εἴδους πονηροῦ ἀπέχεσθε.

verses.restored: Now may the Divine of peace himself sanctify you wholly, and may your whole spirit and soul/life and body be kept blameless at the presence/arrival of our Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς, καὶ ὁλόκληρον ὑμῶν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἀμέμπτως ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τηρηθείη.

verses.restored: Trustworthy is the One calling you, who also will do it.

familiar.text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

modern.text: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.

original.text: πιστὸς ὁ καλῶν ὑμᾶς, ὃς καὶ ποιήσει.

verses.restored: Siblings, pray also for us.

familiar.text: Brethren, pray for us.

modern.text: Brothers, pray for us as well.

original.text: Ἀδελφοί, ⸀προσεύχεσθε περὶ ἡμῶν.

verses.restored: Greet all the siblings with a holy kiss.

familiar.text: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

modern.text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

original.text: ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς πάντας ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ.

verses.restored: I adjure you by the Lord that the letter be read to all the siblings.

familiar.text: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

modern.text: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.

original.text: ⸀ἐνορκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν κύριον ἀναγνωσθῆναι τὴν ἐπιστολὴν πᾶσιν ⸀τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς.

verses.restored: The grace of our Lord Jesus Messiah be with you.

familiar.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

modern.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

original.text: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθʼ ⸀ὑμῶν.

translation_notes: Armor imagery is sober resilience: breastplate of trust/love and helmet of hope, not aggression toward people.
Spirit, soul/life, and body in 5:23 protects whole-person sanctification rather than body rejection.
Community instructions are practical peace practices: encourage, hold close, be patient, pursue good, test prophecy, do not quench Spirit.
